description: Enroll a child in a daycare program from initial inquiry through family onboarding.

steps.description: Receive and respond to a daycare enrollment inquiry with program details and availability.

inputs.name: family-contact-info
inputs.desc: Name, phone, email of the inquiring parent or guardian

inputs.name: child-age-and-needs
inputs.desc: Age of the child and any special needs or requests

outputs.name: program-options
outputs.desc: Available programs matching the child's age group with schedules and rates

outputs.name: tour-scheduled
outputs.desc: Confirmed date and time for the facility tour

process: Check which age-group classrooms have open spots.
Match the child's age to the available programs (infant, toddler, preschool, school-age).
Provide the program details (schedule, tuition, meals, curriculum approach) to the family.
Schedule a facility tour at a mutually available time.

steps.description: Collect and verify all required enrollment forms from the family.

inputs.name: program-options
inputs.desc: The program the family selected after the tour

inputs.name: tour-scheduled
inputs.desc: Tour completion confirmation

outputs.name: enrollment-packet
outputs.desc: Completed enrollment forms (child info, medical history, emergency contacts, pickup authorizations, consent forms)

outputs.name: missing-items
outputs.desc: Any forms or documents still outstanding

process: Send the enrollment packet to the family (child information form, medical history, emergency contacts, authorized pickup list, photo/media consent, handbook acknowledgment).
Receive and review each returned form for completeness.
Flag any missing signatures, fields, or required documents.
Follow up on outstanding items within the deadline.

steps.description: Verify the child's immunization records against state requirements.

inputs.name: enrollment-packet
inputs.desc: The completed enrollment forms including medical records

outputs.name: immunization-status
outputs.desc: Whether the child's immunizations are current, pending, or exempt

outputs.name: compliance-notes
outputs.desc: Any immunizations due soon or exemption documentation on file

process: Compare the child's immunization record against the state-required schedule for their age.
Identify any missing or upcoming immunizations.
Record any exemptions (medical, religious) with supporting documentation.
Notify the family of any immunizations needed before the start date.

steps.description: Assign the child to a classroom and set the start date.

inputs.name: immunization-status
inputs.desc: Confirmed immunization compliance or exemption

inputs.name: enrollment-packet
inputs.desc: Completed enrollment forms with child details

outputs.name: classroom-assignment
outputs.desc: Assigned classroom, lead teacher, and age group

outputs.name: start-date
outputs.desc: Confirmed first day of attendance

process: Check the current enrollment count for each eligible classroom against ratio limits.
Assign the child to the classroom with available capacity in their age group.
Coordinate with the lead teacher on the start date and any transition plan.
Confirm the start date with the family.

steps.description: Onboard the family with orientation, communication setup, and first-day preparation.

inputs.name: classroom-assignment
inputs.desc: The child's classroom and teacher assignment

inputs.name: start-date
inputs.desc: The confirmed first day

outputs.name: onboarding-checklist
outputs.desc: Completed orientation items (tour, handbook review, communication app setup, supply list)

outputs.name: enrollment-record
outputs.desc: Final enrollment record with all documentation confirmed

process: Schedule and conduct the family orientation (facility walkthrough, introduce the teacher, review policies).
Set up the family on the communication app (daily reports, messaging, billing).
Provide the supply list and label instructions for the child's items.
Confirm the first-day drop-off and pickup logistics.
File the completed enrollment record.

description: Produce and distribute daily care reports to parents documenting the child's day.

steps.description: Log the child's activities, meals, naps, and milestones throughout the day.

inputs.name: child-roster
inputs.desc: List of children in the classroom with any daily notes from parents

inputs.name: daily-schedule
inputs.desc: The planned schedule for the day (activities, mealtimes, nap times)

outputs.name: activity-log
outputs.desc: Timestamped record of each child's meals, naps, diaper changes, and activities

outputs.name: milestone-notes
outputs.desc: Any developmental milestones or notable moments observed

process: Record meal intake (what was served, how much the child ate, any allergies noted).
Log nap times (start, end, quality).
Record diaper changes or bathroom visits as applicable for the age group.
Note participation in activities (art, outdoor play, circle time, free play).
Document any milestones (first steps, new words, social interactions).

steps.description: Note any health, behavior, or safety concerns observed during the day.

inputs.name: activity-log
inputs.desc: The day's activity log for all children

outputs.name: concern-flags
outputs.desc: Any health symptoms, behavioral concerns, or incidents requiring parent notification

outputs.name: positive-highlights
outputs.desc: Positive moments to share with parents (achievements, kindness, creativity)

process: Review the activity log for any health signs (fever, rash, lethargy, reduced appetite).
Note any behavioral concerns (biting, persistent crying, withdrawal).
Identify positive highlights worth sharing with the family.
Flag any items requiring immediate parent contact versus end-of-day reporting.

steps.description: Compile the daily report for each child and distribute to parents.

inputs.name: activity-log
inputs.desc: The day's activity log

inputs.name: concern-flags
inputs.desc: Any flagged concerns

inputs.name: positive-highlights
inputs.desc: Positive moments to share

outputs.name: daily-reports
outputs.desc: Individual daily reports for each child ready for distribution

outputs.name: distribution-confirmation
outputs.desc: Confirmation that all reports were sent to parents

process: Compile each child's activity log, highlights, and any concerns into the daily report format.
Attach any photos taken during the day (with consent).
Send the reports to parents via the communication app before pickup time.
Log the distribution confirmation.

steps.description: Handle parent responses and questions about the daily report.

inputs.name: daily-reports
inputs.desc: The sent daily reports

inputs.name: distribution-confirmation
inputs.desc: Confirmation of report delivery

outputs.name: parent-feedback-log
outputs.desc: Log of parent questions, comments, and any follow-up actions needed

outputs.name: next-day-notes
outputs.desc: Notes to carry forward to the next day based on parent input

process: Monitor for parent responses to the daily reports.
Answer questions about the child's day (meals, naps, activities).
Log any parent requests or instructions for the following day.
Escalate any concerns that require a director or lead teacher conversation.

description: Maintain ongoing compliance with state childcare licensing requirements.

steps.description: Identify and document all applicable state childcare licensing requirements.

inputs.name: facility-type
inputs.desc: Type of childcare facility (center, family home, group home)

inputs.name: state-jurisdiction
inputs.desc: State and local jurisdiction for licensing rules

outputs.name: requirements-checklist
outputs.desc: Complete list of licensing requirements (ratios, qualifications, facility standards, training, health and safety)

outputs.name: renewal-timeline
outputs.desc: License renewal dates and required submission deadlines

process: Look up the state licensing regulations for the facility type.
Document the staff-to-child ratio requirements by age group.
List the staff qualification requirements (education, certifications, background checks).
List the facility requirements (square footage, outdoor space, safety equipment, fire inspection).
Record the ongoing training hour requirements for all staff.

steps.description: Track staff qualifications, certifications, and background check status.

inputs.name: requirements-checklist
inputs.desc: The licensing requirements for staff qualifications

outputs.name: staff-compliance-status
outputs.desc: Each staff member's current compliance status (background checks, CPR/First Aid, training hours, credentials)

outputs.name: upcoming-expirations
outputs.desc: Certifications or clearances expiring in the next 90 days

process: Inventory each staff member's current credentials (degree, CDA, state credentials).
Verify background check completion and renewal dates.
Track CPR and First Aid certification expiration dates.
Calculate remaining training hours needed for the licensing period.
Flag any staff members approaching expiration on required items.

steps.description: Audit the facility against licensing standards for health, safety, and environment.

inputs.name: requirements-checklist
inputs.desc: The facility requirements from licensing regulations

inputs.name: staff-compliance-status
inputs.desc: Current staff compliance status

outputs.name: facility-audit-results
outputs.desc: Pass/fail status for each facility requirement with notes on any deficiencies

outputs.name: corrective-actions
outputs.desc: List of items needing correction before the next inspection

process: Walk through each classroom checking square footage, maximum capacity postings, and emergency exits.
Verify health and safety items (fire extinguishers, first aid kits, medication storage, cleaning supplies locked).
Check outdoor play areas (fencing, surfacing, equipment condition).
Verify required postings are displayed (license, ratios, emergency plans, menus, allergy lists).
Document any deficiencies and assign corrective action owners and deadlines.

steps.description: Prepare for a licensing inspection by verifying all records and facility standards.

inputs.name: facility-audit-results
inputs.desc: Results of the most recent internal facility audit

inputs.name: corrective-actions
inputs.desc: Outstanding corrective actions

outputs.name: inspection-readiness
outputs.desc: Confirmation that all records, postings, and facility items are ready for inspection

outputs.name: compliance-record
outputs.desc: Complete compliance file with all documentation organized for the inspector

process: Verify all corrective actions from the internal audit are completed.
Organize the compliance binder (staff files, child files, fire drill logs, injury reports, training records).
Confirm all required postings are current and visible.
Brief staff on the inspection process and their responsibilities.
Conduct a final walkthrough the day before the expected inspection window.

description: Manage childcare billing from rate setup through payment collection and subsidy processing.

steps.description: Set up the tuition rates and fee schedule for the childcare program.

inputs.name: program-list
inputs.desc: List of programs offered with age groups and schedules (full-time, part-time, drop-in)

inputs.name: cost-analysis
inputs.desc: Operating cost per child by program type

outputs.name: rate-schedule
outputs.desc: Published tuition rates by program, schedule, and any sibling or multi-day discounts

outputs.name: fee-policy
outputs.desc: Late payment fees, registration fees, supply fees, and other charges

process: Calculate the break-even tuition per child by program type based on operating costs.
Set the tuition rates with margin targets for each program.
Define the discount structure (sibling discounts, multi-child, prepayment).
Document the fee schedule (registration, late pickup, late payment, returned check).
Publish the rate schedule and fee policy.

steps.description: Generate monthly invoices for enrolled families.

inputs.name: rate-schedule
inputs.desc: Current tuition rates and fee schedule

inputs.name: fee-policy
inputs.desc: Late fees and additional charges policy

outputs.name: monthly-invoices
outputs.desc: Invoices for each enrolled family with line items for tuition, fees, credits, and balance due

outputs.name: billing-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of total invoiced amount, expected collections, and outstanding balances

process: Pull the enrollment roster and each family's program and schedule.
Calculate the tuition for the billing period, applying any discounts.
Add any additional charges (late pickup fees, supply fees, field trip fees).
Apply any credits (absences per policy, prepayment credits, subsidy payments received).
Generate and distribute the invoices by the billing date.

steps.description: Process tuition payments and track collection status.

inputs.name: monthly-invoices
inputs.desc: The invoices sent to families

outputs.name: payment-ledger
outputs.desc: Record of payments received with date, amount, method, and family

outputs.name: past-due-accounts
outputs.desc: List of accounts past due with amount owed and days overdue

process: Record each payment received (ACH, credit card, check, cash) against the family's invoice.
Apply late fees per the fee policy when payment is past the due date.
Send payment reminders at defined intervals (due date, 7 days past, 14 days past).
Flag accounts for director follow-up when past due beyond the threshold.

steps.description: Manage billing for families receiving childcare subsidies or vouchers.

inputs.name: payment-ledger
inputs.desc: Payment records showing private-pay and subsidy portions

inputs.name: past-due-accounts
inputs.desc: Past due accounts for reconciliation

outputs.name: subsidy-claims
outputs.desc: Claims submitted to subsidy programs with attendance documentation

outputs.name: billing-record
outputs.desc: Complete billing record reconciling private pay, subsidy, and outstanding balances

process: Identify families receiving state vouchers, employer subsidies, or other assistance.
Track attendance for subsidy-eligible families (most programs require attendance documentation).
Submit claims to the subsidy program with the required attendance records.
Reconcile subsidy payments received against claims submitted.
Invoice the family for any copay or balance not covered by the subsidy.

description: Plan the daycare curriculum by age group with developmental goals, weekly themes, and activities.

steps.description: Define the developmental goals for the age group across all domains.

inputs.name: age-group
inputs.desc: The age group for the curriculum (infant, toddler, preschool, school-age)

inputs.name: assessment-data
inputs.desc: Current developmental observations and assessments for children in the group

outputs.name: developmental-goals
outputs.desc: Goals organized by domain (cognitive, language, social-emotional, physical, creative)

outputs.name: focus-areas
outputs.desc: Priority areas based on the current group's needs and interests

process: Review the age-appropriate developmental milestones for each domain.
Assess where the current group of children is relative to those milestones.
Identify the focus areas where the group would benefit from targeted activities.
Set measurable goals for the planning period (month or quarter).

steps.description: Plan weekly themes and activities aligned with developmental goals.

inputs.name: developmental-goals
inputs.desc: Goals by developmental domain

inputs.name: focus-areas
inputs.desc: Priority areas for the group

outputs.name: weekly-plan
outputs.desc: Theme, daily activities, and materials for the week organized by day and time block

outputs.name: materials-list
outputs.desc: Supplies and materials needed for the planned activities

process: Select the weekly theme based on the developmental goals, children's interests, and seasonal relevance.
Plan daily activities that address multiple developmental domains through the theme.
Include a mix of structured and free-play activities, indoor and outdoor time.
List the materials and supplies needed for each activity.
Build in flexibility for children who need modified activities.

steps.description: Document learning outcomes and share curriculum highlights with parents.

inputs.name: weekly-plan
inputs.desc: The weekly plan that was executed

inputs.name: materials-list
inputs.desc: Materials used

outputs.name: outcome-observations
outputs.desc: Documented observations of children's learning and development during activities

outputs.name: parent-curriculum-update
outputs.desc: Summary sent to parents about what their children are learning and how to extend it at home

process: Observe and document children's engagement, progress, and challenges during each activity.
Note individual milestones or breakthroughs worth sharing with families.
Compile the weekly curriculum summary for parents (what was learned, upcoming themes).
Suggest home extension activities parents can do to reinforce the learning.

steps.description: Review the curriculum effectiveness and adapt for the next planning cycle.

inputs.name: outcome-observations
inputs.desc: Documented learning outcomes from the executed plan

inputs.name: parent-curriculum-update
inputs.desc: Parent feedback on curriculum updates

outputs.name: curriculum-evaluation
outputs.desc: Assessment of which activities worked, which need modification, and what to repeat

outputs.name: curriculum-plan
outputs.desc: Updated curriculum plan incorporating lessons learned for the next cycle

process: Review the outcome observations against the developmental goals set for the period.
Identify activities that produced strong engagement and learning versus those that fell flat.
Incorporate parent feedback and suggestions.
Adjust the next cycle's plan based on what worked, children's evolving interests, and remaining goal gaps.

description: Schedule childcare staff to maintain required staff-to-child ratios at all times.

steps.description: Calculate the minimum staff needed by time block based on enrollment and ratio requirements.

inputs.name: enrollment-by-classroom
inputs.desc: Number of enrolled children by age group and classroom

inputs.name: ratio-requirements
inputs.desc: State-mandated staff-to-child ratios by age group

outputs.name: staffing-minimums
outputs.desc: Minimum staff required by classroom and time block (open, midday, close)

outputs.name: coverage-gaps
outputs.desc: Time blocks where current staffing levels are below minimum

process: Calculate the required staff count for each classroom based on enrollment and the mandated ratio.
Map the staffing needs across the full operating day, accounting for staggered arrivals and departures.
Identify the peak staffing periods (usually mid-morning to mid-afternoon).
Flag any time blocks where the current staff count would violate ratio requirements.

steps.description: Collect staff availability and schedule preferences for the upcoming period.

inputs.name: staffing-minimums
inputs.desc: Required staff by classroom and time block

outputs.name: availability-matrix
outputs.desc: Each staff member's available days and times for the scheduling period

outputs.name: time-off-requests
outputs.desc: Approved and pending time-off requests

process: Send the availability request to all staff for the upcoming schedule period.
Collect availability submissions (available days, preferred hours, blackout dates).
Process any new time-off requests against the coverage needs.
Compile the availability matrix showing who is available for each time block.

steps.description: Build the staff schedule ensuring ratio compliance across all time blocks.

inputs.name: availability-matrix
inputs.desc: Staff availability by day and time

inputs.name: staffing-minimums
inputs.desc: Required staff by classroom and time block

inputs.name: time-off-requests
inputs.desc: Approved time-off

outputs.name: published-schedule
outputs.desc: Final staff schedule by day, shift, and classroom assignment

outputs.name: substitute-needs
outputs.desc: Shifts requiring substitute coverage that could not be filled from regular staff

process: Assign staff to shifts starting with the hardest-to-fill time blocks (early open, late close).
Ensure every time block meets or exceeds the ratio minimum for each classroom.
Balance hours across staff according to their contracted hours and preferences.
Identify any remaining gaps that need substitute teachers.
Publish the schedule and notify all staff of their assignments.

steps.description: Handle staff callouts and coordinate substitute coverage.

inputs.name: published-schedule
inputs.desc: The current published schedule

inputs.name: substitute-needs
inputs.desc: Known substitute needs

outputs.name: updated-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule updated with substitute assignments or internal coverage shifts

outputs.name: staff-schedule
outputs.desc: Final schedule with hours tracked for payroll processing

process: When a callout is received, check the ratio impact on the affected classroom.
Contact available substitute teachers from the sub list in priority order.
If no substitute is available, adjust internal staff (float teachers, director coverage).
Update the schedule and notify affected staff.
Track actual hours worked for payroll at the end of the period.

description: Set up and manage the parent communication system for a childcare center.

steps.description: Select and configure the communication platform for parent-center communication.

inputs.name: center-size
inputs.desc: Number of enrolled families and classrooms

inputs.name: communication-needs
inputs.desc: Required communication types (daily reports, billing, announcements, emergencies, messaging)

outputs.name: platform-selection
outputs.desc: Selected communication platform with the setup configuration

outputs.name: channel-structure
outputs.desc: Communication channels defined (center-wide, classroom-specific, individual family, emergency)

process: Evaluate communication platforms against the center's needs (daily reporting, photo sharing, billing, messaging).
Select the platform that covers the required features within the budget.
Define the channel structure (center-wide announcements, per-classroom updates, individual family messaging, emergency broadcast).
Configure the platform with the center's branding and settings.

steps.description: Configure the message types, templates, and automation rules.

inputs.name: platform-selection
inputs.desc: The selected communication platform

inputs.name: channel-structure
inputs.desc: Defined communication channels

outputs.name: message-templates
outputs.desc: Templates for recurring messages (daily reports, weekly newsletters, billing reminders, closures, emergencies)

outputs.name: automation-rules
outputs.desc: Automated message triggers (daily report distribution, payment reminders, birthday greetings)

process: Create templates for each recurring message type (daily report, weekly newsletter, monthly billing, closure notice).
Set up the emergency communication protocol (severe weather, facility issue, health advisory).
Configure automation rules for routine messages (daily report at 4 PM, billing reminder on the 1st).
Define the response expectations (staff response time for parent messages, escalation for urgent issues).

steps.description: Set up photo and video sharing with privacy controls and consent management.

inputs.name: message-templates
inputs.desc: Communication templates including photo-based daily reports

outputs.name: privacy-controls
outputs.desc: Photo sharing rules, consent status for each family, and distribution restrictions

outputs.name: sharing-guidelines
outputs.desc: Staff guidelines for taking and sharing photos and videos of children

process: Review each family's photo and media consent form status.
Configure the platform to restrict photo visibility (only parents of children in the photo, or classroom-only sharing).
Write the staff guidelines for photography (when, where, what is appropriate, no social media).
Set up the review process for any photos before distribution.

steps.description: Onboard families onto the communication system and establish expectations.

inputs.name: privacy-controls
inputs.desc: Configured privacy settings

inputs.name: sharing-guidelines
inputs.desc: Photo sharing guidelines

outputs.name: family-activation-status
outputs.desc: List of families with their activation status on the communication platform

outputs.name: communication-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete communication system documentation for staff and families

process: Send the platform invitation to all enrolled families with setup instructions.
Track which families have activated their accounts and follow up on any who have not.
Share the communication guidelines with families (how to message staff, expected response times, emergency contacts).
Compile the full communication system documentation for the staff handbook.

description: Handle and report incidents at a childcare facility including injuries, illnesses, and behavioral events.

steps.description: Document the incident with all required details immediately after it occurs.

inputs.name: incident-description
inputs.desc: What happened (injury, illness, behavioral event, allegation, facility issue)

inputs.name: involved-parties
inputs.desc: Names and roles of children, staff, and witnesses involved

outputs.name: incident-report-draft
outputs.desc: Written incident report with date, time, location, description, parties, and immediate actions taken

outputs.name: severity-classification
outputs.desc: Severity level (minor, moderate, serious, reportable to licensing)

process: Record the date, time, and exact location of the incident.
Write a factual description of what happened (avoid interpretation or blame).
List all involved parties and witnesses with their roles.
Document the immediate response (first aid administered, child comforted, area secured).
Classify the severity based on the center's incident classification policy.

steps.description: Notify the parents of involved children according to the severity and notification policy.

inputs.name: incident-report-draft
inputs.desc: The draft incident report

inputs.name: severity-classification
inputs.desc: The severity level of the incident

outputs.name: parent-notification-record
outputs.desc: Record of when and how each parent was notified, including their response

outputs.name: signed-incident-acknowledgment
outputs.desc: Parent signature acknowledging the incident report at pickup

process: For serious incidents, call the parents immediately.
For moderate incidents, notify by the end of the day via the communication app and in person at pickup.
For minor incidents, include in the daily report and discuss at pickup.
Have the parent sign the incident report acknowledgment at pickup.
Document the notification timeline and parent response.

steps.description: Determine whether the incident requires a report to the licensing authority and file if required.

inputs.name: incident-report-draft
inputs.desc: The incident report

inputs.name: severity-classification
inputs.desc: The severity classification

outputs.name: licensing-report-status
outputs.desc: Whether a licensing report was filed, with the filing confirmation or the reason it was not required

outputs.name: regulatory-deadline-tracker
outputs.desc: Any regulatory deadlines for follow-up actions or additional reporting

process: Check the state licensing regulations for reportable incident categories (hospitalization, broken bone, head injury, allegation, death, communicable disease).
If the incident meets a reportable threshold, complete the licensing agency's incident report form within the required timeframe.
Submit the report to the licensing authority and retain the confirmation.
Track any follow-up requirements or deadlines imposed by the licensing agency.

steps.description: Investigate the root cause and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

inputs.name: parent-notification-record
inputs.desc: Parent notification status

inputs.name: licensing-report-status
inputs.desc: Licensing report status

outputs.name: root-cause-finding
outputs.desc: Identified root cause or contributing factors

outputs.name: incident-report
outputs.desc: Final incident report with corrective actions, responsible parties, and implementation dates

process: Interview the staff and witnesses to understand what led to the incident.
Identify the root cause (supervision gap, environmental hazard, policy gap, individual behavior).
Develop corrective actions (policy change, environmental fix, additional training, schedule adjustment).
Assign responsible parties and implementation dates for each corrective action.
File the complete incident report in the child's record and the center's incident log.
